title: Oozy Russian Tofu Croquettes
description: Fermented, crisp, adventurous Russian dish featuring marinated tofu, deep-fried to golden perfection in a kazan cauldron and served with a splash of fish sauce.
instructions: Press tofu for 20 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Marinate the tofu cubes in soy sauce, fermented fish sauce, grated ginger, minced garlic, pepper and salt for 30 minutes.
In a shallow bowl combine flour and potato starch. Dredge marinated tofu pieces in the mixture, shaking off excess.
Beat the egg in a separate bowl and dip each coated tofu cube into the egg, then back into the flour mixture for an extra crust.
Heat oil to 180°C in a kazan cauldron or deep pan. Fry tofu croquettes in batches until golden brown, about 4 minutes each side.
Remove croquettes with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot, sprinkled with sesame seeds and optional smoked salmon slices.
Enjoy the crispy, fermented flavor of this Russian tofu classic.
